title: Bounded maps: clock order and refused-charge entries (low)
evidence: (2) done: createQuotaCounter's charge refuses a charge over the whole limit before it touches the map (rate-limiter.ts charge, US-52 AC4i), and a new key's charge within the limit always fits its fresh count, so a refused charge leaves no entry. (1) left, for the owner: boundedMap in rate-limiter.ts takes insertion order as expiry order, which holds while Date.now() never steps back. A one-use set (US-52 AC16) then only refuses early until the next sweep, so it fails closed. Low priority. From the PR 1613 review
